name: Twin Towers
design_intent:
TWIN TOWERS — THE HIGH WIRE #12 (tier 3, two tall pillars + a low bridge isle). Two tall trampoline tower-tops (top y640) flank a LOW central bridge isle (top y1160) over TWO deep starfield voids, split by two 620px gaps, each tower crowned by a spring throne (+520). The low centre is the contested crossroads; the towers and their thrones are the high ground. A big-vertical-spread three-lane fight over twin abysses. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: paired tall towers with a sunken middle (Zenith orbits one apex; the ridges are flat). Feel = 'hold a tower, own its throne, and knock rivals off into either abyss.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 620px in ~0.9s; super 2800 clears all). Tower L x0..700 top640; centre isle x1320..1940 top1160 (bubblegum); tower R x2560..3260 top640; thrones spring x100..460 top120 (L) and x2800..3160 top120 (R):
- GAP tower<->centre isle (both sides): tower-edge-to-isle-edge = 620px horizontal AND ~520px vertical drop/climb (a diagonal over the void). 620 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395/320. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into a deep void. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB tower -> its THRONE (top y120): 520px above the tower top (640). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y370 -> short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER). (Rule B, >= 520.)
- CLIMB centre isle -> a tower: 520px up AND 620px across (the isle sits a full tower-height below). JETPACK REQUIRED both dimensions. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: centre isle bottom 1256 -> bottom blast line 2160 = 904px of recovery sky (deeper under the towers) -> a fuelled knock boosts back; the twin voids mean a hit in either direction is a real gamble. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce clears a 620px gap or climbs a 520px throne, so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
